content: At the start of a [group test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/group-test) or [montage test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/montage-test), you can spend a [hero token](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/hero-token). If you do, all participants make [tests](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) as if they also had any skill you have from the [exploration group](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.group/exploration).
